hero.lead: Set in a peaceful residential neighborhood away from the tourist crowds, our monthly apartments offer a perfect balance of authentic Bali living and modern connectivity.

manifesto.line1: Too long for a hotel, too short for a lease.

story.emphasis: but built for the long haul
story.p1: Puri Liang is not a resort. We have a pool, but it is not an infinity pool, and we are not on the beach. We are a regular residence built for families and colleagues spending a few months on the island.
story.p2: Everything here is set up so daily life just works. Wi-Fi, water, weekly housekeeping, and towel changes are included in the monthly rate, so costs don't pile up later — the only extra is in-room electricity, which is prepaid. Hot water around the clock, and staff who respond even on weekends.
story.quote: "Too long for a hotel, too short for a lease. We exist to fill that gap."

hero.lead: Not at the center of any tourist area, but at a kind of "crossroads" — easy access in every direction, while sidestepping the worst of Bali's traffic.

crossroads.title1: Not in the middle of a tourist hub —
crossroads.emphasis: in the middle of all of them
crossroads.lead: Sidakarya sits slightly outside Bali's main tourist areas, but lets you reach the major districts in every direction in a relatively short drive.
crossroads.mapCaption: Approximate distances from Puri Liang Residence to the main areas

directions.title: Toward Sanur
directions.body: Close to a newly opened international hospital in a special medical zone, the ferry port for nearby islands (Nusa Lembongan / Penida), and fast-developing Sanur. Handy for hospital visits and island hopping during a long stay.

directions.title: Toward Seminyak / Canggu
directions.body: Several access roads lead toward Seminyak, Canggu, Kuta, and Legian, so you can pick your route depending on traffic. Easy to reach for weekend nightlife and beach clubs.

directions.title: Toward Nusa Dua / Uluwatu
directions.body: Close to the toll road entrance — a shortcut to Nusa Dua, Benoa, and Uluwatu. Kura Kura Island, where a large shopping mall and a special financial zone are under development, is also reachable without sitting in traffic.

directions.title: Toward Ubud
directions.body: Close to the main road to Ubud — most trips take under an hour. Easy for weekend day trips to yoga studios, rice terraces, and markets.

around.title: From our door, on foot or by car.
around.lead: How far is it from here? We list the distance, travel time, and how to get there — with honest travel times to the tourist hubs.

items.title: Mertasari Beach (Sanur)
items.detail: 5 min by car (or 10 min by bike). Calm water and a famous sunrise spot — great for kitesurfing and yoga.

items.title: Local supermarket
items.detail: 10-min walk or 3-min drive. Everyday essentials, groceries, imported foods, and local fruit.

items.title: Local warung & cafe
items.detail: 5 min on foot. Breakfast from Rp 25,000, coffee around Rp 18,000.

items.title: ATM
items.detail: 1 min on foot. Accepts Visa / Mastercard. Several banks and money changers nearby.

items.title: Ngurah Rai Intl. Airport
items.detail: About 30 min by taxi (via the bypass or toll road). Airport pickup can be arranged for Rp 300,000.

items.title: Central Ubud
items.detail: 50 min by car. Yoga, markets, rice terraces — great for day trips.

items.title: Kuta / Seminyak / Canggu
items.detail: 30–45 min by car. Shopping, dining, nightlife, and beach clubs.

items.title: Central Sanur & harbor
items.detail: 10 min by car. Stylish cafes and restaurants, plus fast boats to Nusa Penida and Lembongan.

neighborhood.lead: The things you only see when you live somewhere — written honestly.

notes.title: Not a tourist area — and that's the point
notes.body: Sidakarya rarely shows up in guidebooks. That's exactly why the warungs where locals eat breakfast and the squares where they gather in the evening are still here. Everyday Balinese life simply carries on in this area.

notes.title: On safety
notes.body: It's a residential neighborhood, so it stays relatively quiet at night. We don't recommend walking alone late at night, but many women have stayed here on their own long-term. The building entrance is always locked, and shared areas are covered by security cameras.

notes.title: Cost of living
notes.body: A meal at a local warung costs Rp 25,000–50,000 (about US$1.50–3) — roughly half of tourist-area prices. Cooking with groceries from the supermarket is cheaper still. Some residents keep their monthly food costs under US$200.

notes.title: Getting around
notes.body: Renting a motorbike (around Rp 800,000/month) is the norm. If you're not used to riding, Grab or Gojek (ride-hailing apps like Uber) are convenient — drivers pick you up right at the building.

hero.lead: The questions we've been asked most over the past two years, grouped by category. For anything else, please use the reservation form — we reply within two business days.

items.a: Rent, Wi-Fi, utilities for shared areas, weekly housekeeping, and towel changes twice a week. In-room electricity is prepaid (token-based) and not included in the monthly rate: whenever you need to top up during your stay, just hand the amount to our staff and they'll do it for you (roughly Rp 300,000 per person per month). Prices are set in Indonesian rupiah (IDR); JPY and USD amounts are approximate.
The minimum stay is 2 weeks. Consecutive stays of 3 months or more get 10% off the monthly rate, and 6 months or more get 15% off.
By bank transfer (Wise is accepted). Your booking is confirmed once you've paid the rent for your entire stay in advance. At check-in, you pay only the deposit (Rp 2,000,000).
Cancellations made up to 7 days before check-in are fully refunded, minus the actual bank transfer fee (about 1%). Cancellations made less than 7 days before check-in are non-refundable.
Your booking is confirmed once the upfront payment has been completed.
No pets. Smoking is strictly prohibited indoors and allowed only in designated outdoor areas.
Yes, Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and shared areas.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Please ask us about early check-in or late check-out.

items.q: How do I get here from the airport?
items.a: About 30 min by car from Ngurah Rai International Airport. Airport pickup can be arranged (Rp 300,000).

Every room has a kitchenette with a fridge. A stove and basic kitchenware are lent free of charge for stays of 1 month or longer in the King Studio and the Villa. In other cases (stays under 1 month, or the Twin Studio), they can be rented for a fee.
There's a laundry service on the ground floor of the building, open seven days a week. Towel changes twice a week are included in the monthly rate.
Yes. There's a hospital with 24-hour emergency care a 2-minute drive away.
Visitors are allowed only with prior permission.
An extension is treated as a new reservation, so it depends on room availability at that time. If you would like to extend, please let us know as early as possible.
Yes. The Rp 2,000,000 deposit is returned in full at check-out, provided there are no outstanding payments or arrears to management or any party related to Puri Liang.

items.q: Who is responsible for belongings and damage?
items.a: Please look after your own belongings — management is not responsible for any damage or loss. If anything belonging to the residence is damaged or lost through a guest's negligence, the guest will be asked to pay for it. See the terms & conditions for details.

section.title: Terms and Conditions
section.lead: The full terms that apply to every guest staying at Puri Liang Residence. The reservation form asks for your agreement to these terms.

items: A photocopy of a valid ID (passport, etc.) for every occupant must be submitted at check-in. Only registered persons may occupy the room.
Full payment for the entire reservation period must be made in advance to confirm your booking. The deposit is paid separately at check-in.
Cancellations made up to 7 (seven) days before check-in are refunded in full, minus the actual bank transfer fee for the refund. Cancellations made after that are non-refundable.
Receiving guests in the room without prior permission from management is not permitted.
No pets are permitted.
A rental extension is treated as a new reservation and can be accepted only if a room is available.
Management is not responsible for any damage to or loss of the renter's belongings. Renters are responsible for looking after their own belongings.
The renter is obliged to compensate for all damage to and/or loss of property belonging to management, if this occurs due to the renter's negligence.

Renters are required to pay a deposit of Rp 2,000,000 (two million rupiah), which will be returned at check-out provided that the occupant has no outstanding payments or arrears to management or any party related to Puri Liang.
In accordance with government regulations, management is required to report tenants' stays to the local authorities by submitting a copy of each tenant's identity document.
All tenants must help maintain order and respect the privacy of other tenants.
Unlawful acts of any kind are strictly prohibited on the Puri Liang Residence premises.

hero.lead: How Puri Liang Residence ("we") handles the information you share through the reservation form and this website.

sections.title: Information we collect
items: What you enter in the reservation form: your name, email address, preferred room, dates and number of guests, other requests, and display language. Optionally, your WhatsApp/phone number, nationality, and purpose of stay.
A copy of the ID (passport, etc.) of every guest, submitted at check-in.

Information about how you use the site: pages viewed, actions such as clicks and scrolling, device and browser type, approximate location, and similar data (collected using cookies and similar technologies).

sections.title: How we use it
items: To check availability, send quotes, handle your booking, and contact you about your stay.
Your nationality and purpose of stay help us prepare for your stay and give you relevant information.
ID copies are used to register guests with the local authorities, as required by law.
Site usage information helps us make the site easier to use.
We do not use your information for any other purpose.

sections.title: Services we use
items: Inquiries and bookings are managed with Google services (Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Apps Script).
The site is hosted on Vercel. Technical records of access, such as IP addresses, may be kept by Vercel.
Site usage information is measured and analyzed with Google Analytics (Google) and Microsoft Clarity (Microsoft).
The servers of these services may be located outside your country (for example, in the United States).

sections.title: Sharing
items: We share your information with the property's management and staff only as needed to arrange your booking and stay, sometimes via messaging apps such as WhatsApp.
We do not share your information with any other third party without your consent, except where required by law.

sections.title: How long we keep it
items: Two years after your inquiry or check-out, whichever is later, we erase personal details such as your name, contact information, and requests from our booking records.
We also delete related email correspondence after about the same period.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
items: Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity use cookies and similar technologies to understand how the site is used.
You can disable cookies in your browser settings. You can also stop Google Analytics with the opt-out browser add-on provided by Google.

sections.title: Your requests
items: To access, correct, delete, or stop the use of your information, reply to any email we have sent you, or let us know in the "Other requests" field of the reservation form. We will act on your request after confirming your identity.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
items: We may update this policy as needed and will post any changes on this page.
